headline: NCLT Mumbai approves selective reduction of equity capital in Godrej Redevelopers (Mumbai) subsidiary
sum: NCLT Mumbai has approved a selective reduction of equity share capital in Godrej Redevelopers (Mumbai) Private Limited, a step-down subsidiary of Godrej Properties Limited. The approval facilitates capital restructuring within the Godrej group's real estate platform.
implication: Selective capital reduction under NCLT sanction allows listed real-estate groups to optimize subsidiary capital structures without shareholder consent friction; precedent for reduction of paid-up capital in step-down subsidiaries via tribunal approval rather than general meeting resolution.
detail: The National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, issued its order on 25 August 2026 sanctioning the selective reduction of equity share capital of Godrej Redevelopers (Mumbai) Private Limited, a step-down subsidiary of Godrej Properties Limited. Godrej Properties informed the NSE of this development via formal intimation. The reduction is a capital restructuring mechanism available under the Companies Act, 2013, requiring NCLT approval where the reduction is selective (affecting only certain shareholders) or where company objects are presented.
